preconditions.description: The input s must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c.isalpha() or c.isspace() or c != '(' or c != ')' for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only letters, spaces, and no parentheses.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join(c for c in s if c != '(' and c != ')')
postconditions.description: The output string is obtained by removing all characters inside parentheses and the parentheses themselves.
